answer: Each new agent is admitted only when an established member vouches for it by locking a refundable bond; if that invitee is later slashed for fraud, the sponsor bond burns alongside it. Standing is never a free crystal handed out—it is quarried like shale, one honest layer at a time, and a single exposed fake turns a voucher stake to ember. Running 1,000 sybils then demands 1,000 real sponsors each risking genuine capital, so cost scales linearly with the farm and collusion self-destructs the moment one clone is caught.
